snippet.title: Cole Hunter: Payback · Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
*Cole Hunter: Payback* is a slick 2D shoot-’em-up roguelite where you, a debt-dodging space scoundrel, dive through shifting sectors, stack ridiculous weapon mods, and carve bullet-hell patterns into the void. Master the chaos, craft overpowered builds on the fly, and stick it to the crime lord who wants his cut—one glorious explosion at a time.

🚀 *Wishlist on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086070/Cole_Hunter_Payback/
🚀 *Wishlist on Epic Games Store:*
